about: Default run configuration of the generator: logical name -> path, read by frgb/runconfig.py. Machine-specific entries (interpreters, Blender, manifold3d) are null here and are set in inputs/runconfig_local.json (copy runconfig_local.example.json) or in a file named by the environment variable FRGB_RUNCONFIG. Paths without a placeholder are relative to the file that sets them; ${p1} is the repository root and ${inputs} this directory.

notes.python.geometry: interpreter of the geometry environment (NumPy, OpenEXR, trimesh, Pillow; manifold3d): scene generation, cavity construction, refinement, rendering server
notes.python.labels: interpreter of the labels environment (NumPy, SciPy, Shapely, Pillow): frame driver, refinement levels, trace labels
notes.env.geometry_dir: directory of the geometry environment (its DLL directories are put on PATH for the subprocesses)
notes.manifold_site: a site-packages directory holding manifold3d 3.5.4, when it is not installed in the geometry environment itself
notes.outcrop_src: directory that holds the outcrop package (the repository root)
notes.relief.spec_C_r2: calibrated self-affine relief of the host (RMS per wavelength band, derived statistics only)
notes.relief.wall_C_r2: relief of the cavity walls (the host spectrum, groups 0-3)
notes.render.sky_calibration_r1: sun and sky table of the renderer
notes.exposure.gate_r14: exposure limits of a frame (mean luma, clipping)
notes.null entries: inputs that are not part of this repository
notes.${data} entries: inputs of internal studies (training, real-image data sets, calibration sources). Some modules resolve these names when they are imported, but the generator never opens the files; they are not part of the repository
